info.title: pcpm
info.description: pcpm — a fast, disk space efficient package manager for .NET, built on Central Package Management.

commands.name: add
commands.description: Add a package to CPM and to one or more projects.

options.name: --version
options.description:
Explicit version to pin. Defaults to the latest stable
on the feed

options.name: --project
options.description:
Add the PackageReference to a specific project file
only. Repeatable. Default: all projects

options.name: --no-install
options.description: Skip the implicit `pcpm install` at the end

commands.name: audit
commands.description: Security and license audit with optional SBOM generation.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory for SBOM files. Default: ./artifacts/

options.name: --severity
options.description:
Minimum severity to report: low|moderate|high|critical.
Default: low

commands.name: ci
commands.description:
CI-optimised install: verifies lockfile sync, restores from store, runs dotnet
restore.

options.name: --locked-mode
options.description:
Pass --locked-mode to dotnet restore (requires
packages.lock.json to be up to date)

options.name: --no-restore
options.description: Skip the implicit dotnet restore step

commands.name: convert
commands.description: Convert a workspace to Central Package Management (or revert with --revert).

options.name: --revert
options.description:
Revert from CPM: restore Version attributes to
project files

options.name: --dry-run
options.description:
Show what would change without writing any
files

options.name: --force
options.description:
Apply changes without prompting for
confirmation

options.name: --merge
options.description:
Merge collected versions with an existing
Directory.Packages.props instead of
overwriting it
instead of the maximum (default)

options.name: --min-version
options.description:
Pick the minimum version found across projects
instead of the maximum (default)

options.name: --ignore-prerelease
options.description:
Ignore pre-release versions when selecting a
representative version

options.name: --exclude-dirs
options.description:
Regex to exclude directory segments. Default:
^\.|^bin$|^obj$

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check workspace health: CPM correctness, CVEs, orphaned entries, lockfile sync.

options.name: --no-cve
options.description: Skip the CVE check (faster; no network calls)

commands.name: init
commands.description: Initialise a pcpm workspace (CPM, pcpm.json, store).

options.name: --force
options.description:
Overwrite existing pcpm.json / Directory.Packages.props if
they exist

commands.name: install
commands.description: Resolve the dependency graph, populate the store and link to ~/.nuget/packages.

options.name: --no-restore
options.description: Skip the implicit `dotnet restore` at the end

commands.name: outdated
commands.description: Show packages with a newer version available on the feed.

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove a package from CPM and all referencing projects.

commands.name: store
commands.description: Inspect or manage the global content-addressable store.

commands.name: why
commands.description: Show why a package is in the dependency tree.
